tools.name: inspect_native_data_type
tools.title: Inspect Native Data Type
tools.description: Inspect one recovered type by exact database category path or defined typed data address. Returns observed size, alignment, packing, fields, bitfields, enum values, and child type identities; source-level authority and flexible-tail semantics remain unknown unless substantiated.

address.description: Value for address.

document.description: Exact provider document or program identity.

tools.name: inspect_native_instruction
tools.title: Inspect Native Instruction
tools.description: Inspect one exact instruction address: decoded bytes, mnemonic, ordered operand tokens, flow and typed references. Memory addressing decomposition is unavailable when the provider supplies only tokens. Data, interior instruction addresses and undecodable bytes are distinct outcomes.

address.description: Value for address.

document.description: Exact provider document or program identity.

tools.name: resolve_native_call_targets
tools.title: Resolve Native Call Targets
tools.description: Resolve one explicit static call site using typed provider call references. Preserves ambiguous targets as candidates and unresolved computed calls as unknown; does not execute code or traverse a call graph.

address.description: Value for address.

document.description: Exact provider document or program identity.

tools.name: address_name
tools.title: Address Name
tools.description: Resolve the primary analyzed name at a code or data address. Headless providers require an explicit address; GUI providers may default to their current cursor. Null means the provider has no primary name at that address.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

tools.name: comment
tools.title: Comment
tools.description: Read the regular analysis comment at an address, defaulting to the current cursor. This is read-only and returns null when no comment exists; use set_comment to persist a finding.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

tools.name: current_address
tools.title: Current Address
tools.description: Return Hopper's current cursor address for the selected document. Use only for interactive navigation state; prefer explicit addresses in reproducible investigations.

tools.name: current_procedure
tools.title: Current Procedure
tools.description: Return the analyzed procedure containing Hopper's current cursor. This uses GUI cursor state and is not a procedure-name lookup.

tools.name: current_document
tools.title: Current Document
tools.description: Return the document currently selected by REA's Hopper bridge.

tools.name: goto_address
tools.title: Goto Address
tools.description: Move Hopper's GUI cursor to a hexadecimal address and return the resolved address. This changes navigation state but not analysis data; use explicit-address tools for headless workflows.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

tools.name: inline_comment
tools.title: Inline Comment
tools.description: Read the inline instruction comment at an address, defaulting to the current cursor. Returns null when absent; use set_inline_comment to write one.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

tools.name: list_bookmarks
tools.title: List Bookmarks
tools.description: List every bookmark in the selected Hopper document as address and name pairs. Use bookmarks as analyst-authored navigation aids; this does not discover code references.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.title: List Documents
tools.description: List provider program or document identities. Hopper may expose several documents; a Ghidra headless session contains exactly its one imported Program.

tools.name: list_names
tools.title: List Names
tools.description: List every analyzed memory and external symbol as address/value pairs. Provider metadata distinguishes Ghidra primary, dynamic, external, type, and source facts when available.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

tools.name: list_procedures
tools.title: List Procedures
tools.description: List every analyzed procedure as address/value pairs after provider analysis. Ghidra metadata distinguishes thunks and external functions; use returned addresses in later function operations.

tools.name: list_segments
tools.title: List Segments
tools.description: List segments or memory blocks using exclusive end addresses. Ghidra reports block permissions, address space, image base, initialization, and overlay facts; Hopper marks unavailable permissions explicitly.

tools.name: list_strings
tools.title: List Strings
tools.description: List every provider-defined string, or filter to one address, as address/value pairs. Ghidra also reports encoding, terminator status, and byte length.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

tools.name: next_address
tools.title: Next Address
tools.description: Return the next analyzed object address after an explicit address or current cursor. This is a navigation primitive, not instruction-flow or CFG analysis.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

tools.name: prev_address
tools.title: Prev Address
tools.description: Return the previous analyzed instruction start before an explicit address or current cursor. This is a navigation primitive and may fail at document boundaries.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

tools.name: procedure_address
tools.title: Procedure Address
tools.description: Resolve an unambiguous procedure symbol name or provider-normalized address to its canonical entry address. External address spaces remain explicit.

tools.name: procedure_assembly
tools.title: Procedure Assembly
tools.description: Return assembly for one analyzed procedure identified by symbol or hexadecimal address. Use when pseudocode loses calling-convention or instruction-level detail; output is currently returned as one unpaginated string.

tools.name: procedure_callees
tools.title: Procedure Callees
tools.description: Return the provider's resolved direct callees for one procedure identified by symbol or address. Unresolved indirect calls may be absent; use analyze_function and typed references to preserve available edge uncertainty.

tools.name: procedure_callers
tools.title: Procedure Callers
tools.description: Return the provider's resolved direct callers for one procedure identified by symbol or address. Results reflect completed static analysis and may omit unresolved indirect references.

tools.name: procedure_info
tools.title: Procedure Info
tools.description: Return provider metadata for one procedure identified by symbol or address: entrypoint, signature, locals, size, block count, and complete inclusive body ranges when observed. Body byte count and enclosing span remain distinct; unavailable extent is explicit.

tools.name: read_function_instructions
tools.title: Read Function Instructions
tools.description: Return every raw instruction for one analyzed procedure. Instruction text is provider-specific.

tools.name: read_bytes
tools.title: Read Bytes
tools.description: Read analyzed bytes from one provider-normalized virtual address. The hexadecimal payload reports the exact returned length; incomplete reads remain explicit and unsupported provider APIs return typed capability unavailability.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

tools.name: address_to_file_offset
tools.title: Address To File Offset
tools.description: Map one provider-normalized virtual address to its original nonnegative file offset. Unmapped addresses fail explicitly, and providers without an authoritative mapping API return typed capability unavailability.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

tools.name: procedure_references
tools.title: Procedure References
tools.description: Return every raw incoming or outgoing reference edge for one procedure. Endpoint procedures are resolved only from provider containment; Ghidra preserves observed reference kinds while providers without kind authority mark them unavailable.

direction.description: Direction in which to traverse or compare relationships.

tools.name: procedure_pseudo_code
tools.title: Procedure Pseudo Code
tools.description: Decompile one analyzed procedure by symbol name or provider-normalized address. Returns provider-specific pseudocode, never original source or cross-provider text equivalence, and may return null; request procedure_assembly when instruction precision matters.

tools.name: resolve_containing_procedure
tools.title: Resolve Containing Procedure
tools.description: Resolve an arbitrary address, including an interior instruction or exact external entry, to its provider-analyzed containing procedure. A negative result distinguishes outside segments from not in a procedure and is never guessed from nearby symbols.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

tools.name: search_procedures
tools.title: Search Procedures
tools.description: Search every analyzed procedure name using literal matching by default or regex when requested. Results are deterministic and complete.

mode.description: Operation mode that selects the requested behavior.

pattern.description: The literal text or regex pattern to search for

tools.name: search_strings
tools.title: Search Strings
tools.description: Search every analyzed string using literal matching by default or regex when requested. Results are deterministic and complete.

mode.description: Operation mode that selects the requested behavior.

pattern.description: The literal text or regex pattern to search for

tools.name: set_address_name
tools.title: Set Address Name
tools.description: Assign an analyst name to one hexadecimal address and report Hopper's boolean result. This mutates analysis metadata.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

name.description: Exact name used by this operation.

tools.name: set_addresses_names
tools.title: Set Addresses Names
tools.description: Assign analyst names to multiple addresses in one call and return per-address success booleans. This mutates analysis metadata; verify failures individually.

tools.name: set_bookmark
tools.title: Set Bookmark
tools.description: Create or replace a bookmark at a hexadecimal address and report success. This mutates navigation metadata; bookmarks are analyst-authored navigation aids, not binary evidence.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

name.description: Exact name used by this operation.

tools.name: set_comment
tools.title: Set Comment
tools.description: Write a regular analysis comment at a hexadecimal address and return whether readback matched. This mutates the Hopper document; use comments to record evidence IDs or reasoning.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

comment.description: Exact analyst comment text to write.

tools.name: set_current_document
tools.title: Set Current Document
tools.description: Select an already-open Hopper document by exact document name. This changes subsequent default-document routing; list_documents can supply names when needed, while explicit document inputs keep calls reproducible.

document.description: Exact provider document or program identity.

tools.name: set_inline_comment
tools.title: Set Inline Comment
tools.description: Write an inline instruction comment at a hexadecimal address and return whether readback matched. This mutates analysis metadata.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

comment.description: Exact analyst comment text to write.

tools.name: unset_bookmark
tools.title: Unset Bookmark
tools.description: Remove the bookmark at a hexadecimal address and return whether it is absent. This mutates navigation metadata and does not alter binary bytes.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

tools.name: xrefs
tools.title: Xrefs
tools.description: Return analyzed references to a code or data address. Hopper may default to its current cursor; headless providers such as Ghidra require an explicit address. Use to connect strings, globals, selectors, and functions; bare addresses are untyped and indirect references may be incomplete.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

tools.name: inspect_native_dispatch_metadata
tools.title: Inspect Native Dispatch Metadata
tools.description: Inspect the bound provider's name inventory for Objective-C class/method symbols and Swift mangled symbols, returning at most max_records decoded names. Includes target SHA-256 when available, provider identity/version, analysis-profile digest, facet coverage, and per-record Evidence. This is symbol-level evidence, not runtime metadata: ivar layouts, protocol conformances, witness/class tables, and relative pointers are explicitly marked unsupported unless a provider supplies those decoders. The provider controls how its name inventory is acquired.

max_records.description: Maximum permitted records for this operation.

tools.name: get_objc_classes
tools.title: Get Objc Classes
tools.description: Discover and deduplicate Objective-C class labels, optionally filtering by literal substring.

pattern.description: Literal text or regular expression used to filter matching results.

tools.name: get_objc_protocols
tools.title: Get Objc Protocols
tools.description: Discover and deduplicate Objective-C and Swift protocol labels.

tools.name: batch_decompile
tools.title: Batch Decompile
tools.description: Decompile each explicit procedure symbol or address concurrently. Returns ordered per-item success or error results and aggregate counts.

addresses.description: Ordered provider-normalized procedure addresses to analyze.

tools.name: get_call_graph
tools.title: Get Call Graph
tools.description: Traverse the bound provider's caller or callee relationships from one symbol or address until the reachable graph is exhausted. Every node has an ok/error status and failures use safe typed projections; unresolved indirect calls may be missing and results are not a whole-program CFG.

address.description: A provider-normalized procedure address

direction.description: Direction in which to traverse or compare relationships.

tools.name: analyze_swift_types
tools.title: Analyze Swift Types
tools.description: Categorize analyzed procedure names into Swift classes, structs, enums, protocols, extensions, and other symbols. Returns deduplicated names grouped with counts. Optionally select one category and/or apply a case-sensitive literal name filter; for example, use {category: "classes", pattern: "Account"} to find matching class symbols.

category.description: Limit results to one Swift symbol category.

pattern.description: Case-sensitive literal filter applied to mangled symbol names.

tools.name: find_xrefs_to_name
tools.title: Find Xrefs To Name
tools.description: Resolve an exact name against the bound provider's name inventory and return a resolved or unresolved result. Unresolved names use the stable name_not_found reason; this xref workflow returns address-only projections.

name.description: Exact name used by this operation.

tools.name: binary_overview
tools.title: Binary Overview
tools.description: Return native-binary metadata, every segment with its length, and exhaustive procedure/string counts. Use search_procedures, list_procedures, or analyze_function directly when you already know which procedure to inspect.

tools.name: analyze_function
tools.title: Analyze Function
tools.description: Build a dossier for one native function identified by symbol or provider-returned address. Returns identity with complete inclusive body ranges or explicit unknown, provider-specific pseudocode and assembly, comments, calls, references, referenced strings/names, local CFG blocks, and available native API boundary observations.

tools.name: inspect_native_api
tools.title: Inspect Native Api
tools.description: Analyze a native API boundary in one function identified by symbol or provider-returned address. Returns confidence, evidence, jump-table dispatch/data/case mappings, separately evidenced default targets, unsupported branches, and residual unknowns. Null case values mean unresolved cases, never a known default.

tools.name: trace_feature
tools.title: Trace Feature
tools.description: Trace a literal feature query through every matching string and procedure, their xrefs, and truthful containing-procedure resolution. Returns observations, operation count, and residual unknowns without inferring reference kinds.

case_sensitive.description: Whether text matching distinguishes uppercase and lowercase.

query.description: Non-empty feature or text query to investigate.

tools.name: trace_call_path
tools.title: Trace Call Path
tools.description: Trace direct callers or callees from one exact procedure address until the graph is exhausted or the optional goal is reached. Returns visited nodes, direct-call edges, a shortest traversal path, provider failures, and residual unknowns; unresolved indirect calls remain unknown.

direction.description: Direction in which to traverse or compare relationships.

tools.name: trace_native_ui_action
tools.title: Trace Native Ui Action
tools.description: Trace one unique compiled UI action, object ID, native symbol or exact function address through authored connections, encoded or symbolized Objective-C handlers, and bounded static call references. Typed direct and resolved indirect calls, ambiguous candidates, inferred untyped provider callees, and targetless sites remain distinct. Runtime reachability is unknown; use trace_native_values for recovered value dependencies.

action.description: A unique compiled UI action selector, interface object ID, native symbol or exact function address

max_depth.description: Maximum permitted depth for this operation.

max_edges.description: Maximum permitted edges for this operation.

max_nodes.description: Maximum permitted nodes for this operation.

tools.name: trace_native_values
tools.title: Trace Native Values
tools.description: Trace a bounded static dependency graph from one explicit native procedure. Includes high-p-code def-use, constants, operators, memory and branch operations, resolved call edges, and derived argument/parameter and return/output bindings. Missing bindings, alias semantics, persistent state and RNG roles remain unknown. Budgets bound depth, decompilations, graph size and payloads; nodes are paginated.

max_call_sites.description: Maximum permitted call sites for this operation.

max_depth.description: Maximum permitted depth for this operation.

max_edges.description: Maximum permitted edges for this operation.

max_functions.description: Maximum permitted functions for this operation.

max_nodes.description: Maximum permitted nodes for this operation.

tools.name: observe_native_ui
tools.title: Observe Native Ui
tools.description: Observe an already-running native app by PID and window ID, bound to the active Mach-O target. Captures a bounded accessibility tree and selected-window screenshot; OS permission denial fails without broad capture or target launch.

max_nodes.description: Maximum accessibility nodes per capture; increase for large windows.

tools.name: capture_native_ui_scenario
tools.title: Capture Native Ui Scenario
tools.description: Run selected-element press, increment/decrement scroll, AXValue text entry and bounded wait steps in one exact native app window. Returns ordered before/after captures and action/capture failures. Actions can change app data, network activity and persistent state; application state is left as-is and restoration is not attempted.

max_nodes.description: Maximum accessibility nodes per capture; increase for large windows.

tools.name: inspect_macho
tools.title: Inspect Macho
tools.description: Inspect Mach-O slices, load commands, imports, exports, dependencies, build metadata, segments, sections, permissions, and exact command provenance without launching Hopper.

tools.name: inspect_signature
tools.title: Inspect Signature
tools.description: Inspect the active artifact's code-signing identity, hashes, authorities, requirements, entitlements, hardened-runtime state, and exact command provenance.

tools.name: inspect_plist
tools.title: Inspect Plist
tools.description: Parse Info.plist from the active artifact by default, or pass any local plist path. Returns normalized JSON rather than plutil text.

path.description: Local filesystem path used by this operation.

tools.name: list_architectures
tools.title: List Architectures
tools.description: List thin or universal Mach-O slices with offsets, sizes, alignment, explicit coverage, and native-tool provenance.

tools.name: demangle_swift
tools.title: Demangle Swift
tools.description: Demangle an ordered list of Swift symbols without requiring Hopper. Each input returns demangled, unchanged, or invalid status.

tools.name: inspect_artifact
tools.title: Inspect Artifact
tools.description: Inspect an active archive or application package in one call. Returns the complete content-addressed artifact graph, source Evidence, observations, relationships, integrity contradictions, hypotheses, unexplored branches, limitations, and next probes inline. Read-only DMG mounting is used automatically on supported macOS hosts. Integrity mismatches fail by default; record-and-continue keeps mismatches explicitly untrusted. It does not extract files; use extract_artifact to materialize its regular contents.

tools.name: extract_artifact
tools.title: Extract Artifact
tools.description: Extract all regular files from the active archive or application package into a fresh temporary directory chosen by REA. The result includes its location. Rejects traversal and symlink escapes, never overwrites, enforces archive integrity checks, and verifies cleanup.

tools.name: decode_interface_builder
tools.title: Decode Interface Builder
tools.description: Decode compiled storyboard and nib archives inside the active Apple app bundle, including keyed property lists and NIBArchive object tables, into a bounded object, hierarchy, and connection graph. This is static archive parsing; unrecognized archive classes and unresolved code handlers remain explicit unknowns.

max_connections.description: Maximum permitted connections for this operation.

max_documents.description: Maximum permitted documents for this operation.

max_objects.description: Maximum permitted objects for this operation.

tools.name: inspect_keyed_archive
tools.title: Inspect Keyed Archive
tools.description: Inspect one Foundation NSKeyedArchiver plist in the active app bundle as original object-table nodes, class descriptors, named roots, and UID edges. Preserves shared and cyclic references without instantiating classes. The path is relative to the bundle; root selection and object pagination preserve original identities.

path.description: Local filesystem path used by this operation.

tools.name: inspect_asset_catalog
tools.title: Inspect Asset Catalog
tools.description: Inspect compiled Assets.car metadata in an active Apple app bundle. Returns stable paginated catalog and rendition records with raw assetutil metadata and catalog digests; rendition bytes are not extracted.

tools.name: inspect_managed_artifact
tools.title: Inspect Managed Artifact
tools.description: Open and classify an explicit managed PE/CLI path, or inspect the active managed target, then inventory exact assembly/module identity, target framework evidence, references, resources, and custom attributes without loading or executing target code. Returns complete inline inventories when metadata is admitted and explicit partial or malformed coverage otherwise.

path.description: Explicit managed PE/CLI path; omit to reuse the previously selected managed target

tools.name: inspect_managed_members
tools.title: Inspect Managed Members
tools.description: Inspect PE/CLI metadata members, signatures, raw CIL hashes, decoded-instruction-tuple hashes, separately reported exception regions, call edges, and field-access anchors without loading or executing target code. Metadata tokens are reported as build-local coordinates bound to the artifact SHA-256 and MVID; the tuple hash does not resolve them or fully commit control flow.

path.description: Explicit managed PE/CLI path; omit to reuse the previously selected managed target

tools.name: inspect_managed_native_boundaries
tools.title: Inspect Managed Native Boundaries
tools.description: Inspect PE/CLI ModuleRef, ImplMap/PInvoke declarations, CLI native-header indicators, and non-IL method implementation flags without loading or executing target code. Results are managed declarations and degraded native-boundary observations, not verified native exports or addresses.

path.description: Explicit managed PE/CLI path; omit to reuse the previously selected managed target

tools.name: compare_managed_members
tools.title: Compare Managed Members
tools.description: Compare two authenticated inspect_managed_members Evidence records using unique-only decoded-CIL/signature and structural method-shape tiers. Names are reported as observations but are not used as a matching basis; metadata tokens remain build-local coordinates bound to each artifact SHA-256 and MVID, and the tuple digest does not itself remap them.

left.description: Left-hand input used for comparison or differential execution.

right.description: Right-hand input used for comparison or differential execution.

tools.name: verify_managed_native_boundaries
tools.title: Verify Managed Native Boundaries
tools.description: Verify managed P/Invoke/native-boundary declarations against authenticated native export or function Evidence without executing managed code or translating managed metadata tokens into native addresses. The workflow preserves declaration-only, verified, inferred, contradicted, and unresolved states.

native_observations.description: Native function or export Evidence records

tools.name: import_managed_reconstruction
tools.title: Import Managed Reconstruction
tools.description: Import decompiler-produced managed reconstruction against authenticated inspect_managed_members Evidence. The workflow locks each method to artifact SHA-256, MVID, metadata token, signature hash, and the limited decoded-IL tuple hash, records the decompiler identity and options, and marks C# or pseudocode as analyst inference rather than canonical byte observation.

tools.name: project_managed_application_graph
tools.title: Project Managed Application Graph
tools.description: Project authenticated managed artifact, member, and native-boundary Evidence into the provider-neutral application graph without executing managed code, loading assemblies, or translating managed metadata tokens to native addresses. The graph preserves managed static observations as managed-specific nodes linked to source Evidence.

tools.name: list_browser_targets
tools.title: List Browser Targets
tools.description: List page targets exposed by the selected loopback Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint. Optionally filter by exact origin. URLs preserve query values and fragments; only URL userinfo credentials are removed.

cdp_endpoint.description: Literal loopback Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint.

tools.name: inspect_web_page
tools.title: Inspect Web Page
tools.description: Passively inspect one selected page target through CDP without evaluating JavaScript, navigating, clicking, closing, or mutating the page. If no origin filter is supplied, capture is scoped to the target's current origin. Returns DOM structure, accessibility, scripts, resources, attach-window network and console metadata, workers, and redacted storage inventory as Evidence.

tools.name: analyze_web_bundle
tools.title: Analyze Web Bundle
tools.description: Capture JavaScript source from one selected CDP page and statically derive a chunk graph, route and endpoint candidates, vendor fingerprints, page-declared WebMCP metadata, and optionally fetch source maps from the selected target origin or explicitly requested origins. JavaScript is parsed but never executed.

cdp_endpoint.description: Literal loopback Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint.

include_accessibility_text.description: Whether to include accessibility text in the result.

include_console_text.description: Whether to include console text in the result.

include_json_body_shapes.description: Whether to include json body shapes in the result.

include_script_sources.description: Whether to include script sources in the result.

include_storage_fingerprints.description: Whether to include storage fingerprints in the result.

include_storage_keys.description: Whether to include storage keys in the result.

include_websocket_shapes.description: Whether to include websocket shapes in the result.

target_id.description: Exact CDP target identifier selected from the endpoint's target listing.

tools.name: observe_web_session
tools.title: Observe Web Session
tools.description: Arm a CDP observation window of the requested duration while the user operates the page. By default it follows the selected target's current origin; an explicit origin list controls which origins may be retained. Records navigation, redirect, lifecycle, and failure events.

cdp_endpoint.description: Literal loopback Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint.

target_id.description: Exact CDP target identifier selected from the endpoint's target listing.

tools.name: discover_webmcp_tools
tools.title: Discover Webmcp Tools
tools.description: Passively inventory every page-registered WebMCP tool and its complete structural input-schema summary using the experimental CDP WebMCP domain. Metadata is page-declared-untrusted; REA never registers or invokes discovered tools.

cdp_endpoint.description: Literal loopback Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint.

target_id.description: Exact CDP target identifier selected from the endpoint's target listing.

tools.name: compare_web_captures
tools.title: Compare Web Captures
tools.description: Compare passive web captures by providing before and after, or compare recorded scenarios by providing before_scenario and after_scenario with an optional normalization policy. Use exactly one input group. Scenario comparison aligns exact step IDs, records deterministic literal normalization, and returns every artifact-level difference plus alignment failures inline. Missing or truncated evidence never proves equality.

tools.name: capture_web_screenshot
tools.title: Capture Web Screenshot
tools.description: Capture the current visible viewport of one configured page as an inline, content-addressed PNG artifact. The operation never scrolls, navigates, or evaluates page JavaScript.

cdp_endpoint.description: Literal loopback Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint.

target_id.description: Exact CDP target identifier selected from the endpoint's target listing.

tools.name: compare_web_screenshots
tools.title: Compare Web Screenshots
tools.description: Compare two self-verifying PNG screenshot artifacts with local pixel metrics. Returns exact changed-pixel ratios and channel deltas without OCR or external services.

after.description: The later or right-hand observation to compare.

before.description: The earlier or left-hand observation to compare.

tools.name: capture_browser_scenario
tools.title: Capture Browser Scenario
tools.description: Run a controlled browser scenario when passive observation cannot exercise the application. Launch the selected executable or connect to a loopback CDP target, provide a start URL and actions, and select storage or artifacts when needed. Environment, empty storage, and a URL-only final capture are defaults; provide initial storage or additional artifacts when needed. Agents can run their own local fixture servers to control application responses. Actions run until completion or cancellation unless timeout_ms is set. Results are returned inline.

actions.description: Required sequence of explicit browser actions.

browser.description: Required launch/connect selection. Launch uses the selected executable and an owned temporary profile; connect uses one loopback CDP endpoint and target.

capture.description: Optional retained artifacts and event families. Defaults to only a final sanitized URL; request screenshots, DOM, accessibility, history, storage, and event capture explicitly.

environment.description: Optional deterministic browser settings. Defaults to 1280x720, en-US, UTC, light mode, reduced motion, and blocked service workers.

secrets.description: Optional environment-variable references for values used in actions, URLs, storage, or replay, and for redacting matching observed text. Secret values are never supplied inline.

start_url.description: Required initial HTTP(S) URL. Query values must be declared separately as public literals or secret references.

storage.description: Optional initial cookies, local storage, or session storage. Defaults to empty; every supplied value and origin must be declared and within the allowed origins.

tools.name: list_electron_targets
tools.title: List Electron Targets
tools.description: List every Electron file:// page target from a selected loopback CDP endpoint. Local file paths are canonicalized after symlink resolution. Selecting an endpoint exposes every eligible target and its local path metadata.

cdp_endpoint.description: Literal loopback Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint.

tools.name: inspect_electron_page
tools.title: Inspect Electron Page
tools.description: Passively inspect one Electron file page by supplying its loopback CDP endpoint and target ID. The provider rechecks that the target currently exists at that endpoint and is a local file page. Returns frames, DOM structure, resource paths, and scripts without evaluating renderer JavaScript or invoking Electron APIs. The selected endpoint exposes every local file page and its metadata to this tool.

tools.name: analyze_javascript_application
tools.title: Analyze Javascript Application
tools.description: Reconstruct one local ASAR or extracted JavaScript application as an inline application graph without executing it. Returns all recovered graph nodes, edges, semantic relations, limitations, and coverage.

tools.name: reconcile_javascript_runtime
tools.title: Reconcile Javascript Runtime
tools.description: Reconcile verified static JavaScript application graphs with existing passive web/Electron CDP, passive V8 Inspector, or provider-owned active Electron Evidence. Active Electron captures contribute an explicitly partial target-only runtime record; they never invent renderer scripts, frames, workers, or execution claims. Exact captured-source digests take priority over caller-declared file/URL mappings; target, frame, script, and worker ambiguity remains explicit, and source-map authority stays separate.

tools.name: capture_electron_scenario
tools.title: Capture Electron Scenario
tools.description: Use this for a provider-owned Electron run when passive CDP or Inspector observation cannot exercise application behavior. REA owns startup and teardown, accepts caller-defined click/wait actions plus window-targeted renderer reload/crash and synthetic open-url/second-instance delivery, and returns correlated window/WebContents/process/preload/session/navigation/shell/IPC evidence without retaining payload values. Results identify observed and unavailable event families, coverage status, action targets, and truncation. External shell, navigation, permission, download, popup, updater, and OS-integration effects are blocked and recorded. Use passive Electron tools for observation-only work.

application_root.description: Local filesystem application root selected for this operation.

tools.name: list_javascript_runtime_targets
tools.title: List Javascript Runtime Targets
tools.description: List every eligible Node/Electron V8 Inspector target from an explicit literal-loopback endpoint. Node discovery file locations that cannot be verified are preserved as unresolved reported URLs; they do not prove filesystem identity. Listing does not attach to targets.

tools.name: observe_javascript_runtime
tools.title: Observe Javascript Runtime
tools.description: Attach passively to one Node/Electron V8 Inspector target by supplying its loopback Inspector endpoint and target ID. The provider rechecks target presence and attachability; a Node discovery file location may remain unresolved. Loaded script locations are validated independently from Debugger.scriptParsed. Captures script and Runtime execution-context metadata. REA never evaluates, pauses, resumes, reads source, or instruments the target; require/import edges, EventEmitter activity, and Electron IPC remain explicit unknowns. Reconcile the result with static Application Graph Evidence using reconcile_javascript_runtime. The selected endpoint exposes every target it serves to this tool.

target_id.description: Exact CDP target identifier selected from the endpoint's target listing.

tools.name: trace_application_feature
tools.title: Trace Application Feature
tools.description: Trace a typed literal seed through every reachable part of an authenticated JavaScript Application Graph supplied as inline Evidence. Original static, native, passive-runtime, inferred, and unknown authorities remain distinct; native addon handoffs never open a provider or execute the application.

direction.description: Direction in which to traverse or compare relationships.

tools.name: trace_javascript_semantics
tools.title: Trace Javascript Semantics
tools.description: Trace static JavaScript data-flow, direct call/return, and closure relations from inline application Evidence. Dynamic or unsupported semantics remain explicit unknowns; static reachability never claims runtime execution.

query.description: Non-empty feature or text query to investigate.

tools.name: compare_application_versions
tools.title: Compare Application Versions
tools.description: Compare two authenticated JavaScript Application Graph versions supplied as inline Evidence. Uses unique-only exact digest, module source digest, source-map identity, structural fingerprint, and non-module semantic-key tiers. Reports added, removed, changed, ambiguous, and unknown entities plus the complete matching changed_from graph without fuzzy or module-ordinal pairing.

left.description: Left-hand input used for comparison or differential execution.

right.description: Right-hand input used for comparison or differential execution.

tools.name: compare_source_to_bundle
tools.title: Compare Source To Bundle
tools.description: Compare a cryptographically committed HistoricalSourceGraph with inline authenticated JavaScript Application Graph Evidence. Uses explicit exact-digest, source-map path, current-path, suffix, and basename signals with stable weights. Classifies unchanged, modified, removed, split, merged, duplicated, and unknown; incomplete coverage and ambiguous weak signals never become absence or forced matches.

tools.name: compare_javascript_export_shapes
tools.title: Compare Javascript Export Shapes
tools.description: Compare static return shapes for one exact module/export selector on each authenticated JavaScript Application Graph supplied as inline Evidence. Variants pair only by reciprocal unique literal discriminants; dynamic values, incomplete properties, and ambiguous variants remain unknown. Reports JSON Pointer changes without executing JavaScript; runtime behavior requires a separate agent-run probe.

left.description: Left-hand input used for comparison or differential execution.

left_module_path.description: Local filesystem path for left module.

right.description: Right-hand input used for comparison or differential execution.

right_module_path.description: Local filesystem path for right module.

tools.name: build_reconstruction_obligation_ledger
tools.title: Build Reconstruction Obligation Ledger
tools.description: Generate the complete deterministic ReconstructionObligationLedger from an authenticated Evidence bundle, reviewed obligations, and an explicit reconstruction manifest. Static candidates remain candidates; duplicate ownership, missing original or reconstruction cases, missing parser/type, weak verifier authority, unenumerated claims, contradictions, dependencies, and residual unknowns fail closed. The inline result carries the full-ledger closure digest and typed per-obligation diagnostics.

tools.name: evaluate_reconstruction_coverage
tools.title: Evaluate Reconstruction Coverage
tools.description: Evaluate inline evidence-backed reconstruction coverage against one named boundary. Missing ownership or inventory is partial; stale, weak, truncated, skipped, or unresolved proof is unknown; contradictions, failed proof, missing owners, and authority routing fail closed.

boundary_id.description: Exact reconstruction boundary identifier to evaluate.

tools.name: open_binary
tools.title: Open Binary
tools.description: Open a local executable, application bundle, archive, JavaScript, source map, plist, or analysis database after validation. provider_id selects one deep provider or deterministic auto selection; the binding remains stable until close or an explicit switch, with no failure fallback. An optional analysis snapshot is imported atomically and must match the binary identity, concrete provider, and canonical analysis profile exactly.

path.description: Local filesystem path used by this operation.

provider_id.description: Exact deep-analysis provider ID, or automatic selection when omitted.

tools.name: close_binary
tools.title: Close Binary
tools.description: Optionally write a provider-neutral analysis snapshot atomically to the caller-supplied path, then close the active target and every provider resource started for it. Existing files require explicit overwrite; a failed save leaves the session open so cached analysis is not lost.

overwrite.description: Whether an existing destination may be replaced.

tools.name: binary_session
tools.title: Binary Session
tools.description: Report the complete current target, provider, capability availability, client-feature, analysis, and server-identity status without starting analysis.

expected_catalog_digest.description: Expected catalog digest used to reject stale or mismatched input.

expected_package_version.description: Expected package version used to reject stale or mismatched input.

expected_server_path.description: Expected server path used to reject stale or mismatched input.

tools.name: export_evidence_bundle
tools.title: Export Evidence Bundle
tools.description: Atomically write the session's deterministic Evidence bundle to the requested local path. Existing files require overwrite: true; records and manifests use canonical byte-stable ordering.

overwrite.description: Whether an existing destination may be replaced.

path.description: Local filesystem path used by this operation.

tools.name: import_evidence_bundle
tools.title: Import Evidence Bundle
tools.description: Read the JSON bundle at the supplied local path, validate every Evidence ID and canonical manifest, then atomically merge it. Imported content is data only and is never executed.

path.description: Local filesystem path used by this operation.

tools.name: capture_process_scenario
tools.title: Capture Process Scenario
tools.description: Run one caller-selected command under a PTY and return process capture Evidence with residual unknowns. A command name resolves through the inherited PATH; the working directory defaults to the caller's current directory; host environment variables are inherited with scenario overrides. Filesystem snapshots are opt-in through filesystem_observation_paths. The target runs with the current user's permissions; this is not a security sandbox.

executable.description: Command name or executable path to run.

limits.description: Resource budgets that bound execution and retained output for this operation.

tools.name: compare_process_captures
tools.title: Compare Process Captures
tools.description: Compare two compatible process capture observations across terminal, interaction, lifecycle, process, filesystem, command-shim, HTTP, and WebSocket evidence. Optional trace_spec validates exact events against an explicit partial order or finite trace language; concurrency is never inferred from timestamps or broad sorting. Missing, journal-free, or truncated observations are never treated as equivalent.

left.description: Left-hand input used for comparison or differential execution.

max_capture_age_ms.description: Maximum permitted capture age ms for this operation.

right.description: Right-hand input used for comparison or differential execution.

tools.name: compare_artifacts
tools.title: Compare Artifacts
tools.description: Compare complete artifact inventories by logical occurrence path, content identity, metadata, and graph relations. Pass the inventory Evidence nested in each inspect_artifact result as left and right. Every delta cites both inputs, and gaps yield truncated or unknown, never equivalence. Returns every change inline.

left.description: Left-hand input used for comparison or differential execution.

right.description: Right-hand input used for comparison or differential execution.

tools.name: compare_functions
tools.title: Compare Functions
tools.description: Compare two explicit sets of analyze_function Evidence across identity, exact provider text, calls, references, strings, and address-normalized CFG topology. Missing or provider-incompatible facets remain truncated or unknown; every conclusion cites both Evidence sets.

left.description: Left-hand input used for comparison or differential execution.

right.description: Right-hand input used for comparison or differential execution.

tools.name: compare_bundles
tools.title: Compare Bundles
tools.description: Compare two canonical Evidence bundles by exact record membership, explicit one-to-one observation pairs, and complete residual-unknown revision histories. Missing bundle members describe omission only, never behavioral equivalence; output is digest-anchored and returns every change inline.

left_bundle_path.description: Local filesystem path for left bundle.

right_bundle_path.description: Local filesystem path for right bundle.

tools.name: find_changed_behavior
tools.title: Find Changed Behavior
tools.description: Aggregate validated process and artifact comparison Evidence. Runtime observations remain distinct from static behavior candidates; missing or incomplete comparisons produce unresolved findings, never causal claims. Returns every finding inline.

comparisons.description: Validated comparison Evidence records to aggregate.

tools.name: build_call_path
tools.title: Build Call Path
tools.description: Build every shortest direct-callee path inline from complete analyze_function Evidence records using exact canonical addresses. Missing dossiers and provider mixing remain unknown; every node and edge cites source Evidence.

tools.name: correlate_static_and_runtime
tools.title: Correlate Static And Runtime
tools.description: Evaluate every explicit caller-declared hypothesis between exact static comparison findings and runtime comparison dimensions. Similar names or paths are never auto-matched, consistent cochange never proves causality, and unknown or truncated inputs remain unresolved. Returns all correlations and their complete Evidence closure inline.

tools.name: verify_reconstruction
tools.title: Verify Reconstruction
tools.description: Verify a finite typed behavioral and structural specification against a canonical Evidence bundle. Pass means every declared claim has complete comparable authority—not global source equivalence; changed claims fail and missing, limited, or unresolved evidence stays unknown.

tools.name: list_unknowns
tools.title: List Unknowns
tools.description: List every current residual-unknown head in deterministic ID order, with optional exact status, severity, and domain filters. Results are complete and inline. This is read-only; unresolved, contradicted, and non-truth dispositions remain distinct.

tools.name: record_unknown
tools.title: Record Unknown
tools.description: Create one deterministic residual unknown and immutable mutation evidence. Validates all evidence and relationship references, and rejects duplicate stable identity.

contradicting_evidence_ids.description: Ordered Evidence identifiers for the contradicting observations.

question.description: Concrete unresolved question to retain for later investigation.

supporting_evidence_ids.description: Ordered Evidence identifiers for the supporting observations.

tools.name: update_unknown
tools.title: Update Unknown
tools.description: Append one immutable full-state revision and mutation evidence. Requires exact expected_revision; stale concurrent writers fail instead of overwriting newer analysis.

contradicting_evidence_ids.description: Ordered Evidence identifiers for the contradicting observations.

expected_revision.description: Expected revision used to reject stale or mismatched input.

supporting_evidence_ids.description: Ordered Evidence identifiers for the supporting observations.

tools.name: verify_unknown_resolution
tools.title: Verify Unknown Resolution
tools.description: Revalidate the current residual-unknown head against live bundled evidence, exact authority/confidence/environment requirements, and revision integrity. Withdrawn and out-of-scope dispositions are not truth claims.

tools.name: get_evidence_bundle
tools.title: Get Evidence Bundle
tools.description: Return every Evidence record and residual unknown currently retained by this session as one inline bundle for direct inspection or follow-up workflows.

tools.name: get_navigation_context
tools.title: Get Navigation Context
tools.description: Return the selected document, current address, and containing/current procedure in one provider-neutral result. The result reflects sequential provider observations, not an atomic cursor snapshot; a cursor outside any procedure returns procedure: null.

document.description: Exact provider document or program identity.

tools.name: inspect_address_context
tools.title: Inspect Address Context
tools.description: Inspect one explicit reproducible address for its analyzed name, containing procedure, regular and inline comments, and matching bookmarks. Each unsupported facet returns a typed unavailable outcome; use xrefs, assembly, or pseudocode for those deeper views.

address.description: Value for address.

document.description: Exact provider document or program identity.
